### Leverage your digital wallet  

This option makes it faster and easier for you to complete your purchases. The wallet securely stores your payment information for easy transacting and is your one-stop-shop to see your offers, reward points, purchase history, receipt preferences and more. In the coming weeks, we’ll also launch a feature that will let you check in at stores, use your membership benefits and access your rewards through a single QR code. Eventually, we’ll roll out the ability for you to easily pay with this same feature.

### Personalized push notifications and navigation bar

You will more easily be able to get to the information that matters most to you with these options. You can opt-in to receive specific and personalized push notifications that will help alert you when you’ve earned a reward or if it’s about to expire, when the latest smartphone or tablet becomes available for pre-order or even when that product you’ve had your eye on for a while goes on sale.

Shop in our stores often? You can have your “home store” information easily accessible. Or maybe you want to quickly and easily get your hands on the latest from Best Buy Drops™? Just pin that to your navigation bar to stay in-the-know for your best chance at some of our hottest products.

# Benefits of the Best Buy App

Image: Best Buy app

## What is the Best Buy app? 

In today’s world, many consumer purchases are conveniently made from mobile devices. In response to that, Best Buy created an app that’s available to use on your smartphone or tablet. Even better, it’s free to download and install.

## How do I download and install the Best Buy App? 

There are several ways to download and install the Best Buy app. Which method you use depends on what operating system your device uses. For instance, if you have an iPhone, you’ll search for the Best Buy app in the App Store, and if you have an Android device, you can find the Best Buy app on Google Play. Additionally, you can text 332211 from any cell phone and receive a link to download the mobile app.

## What are the benefits of the Best Buy app?

As you’ve likely come to find with other apps, there are many benefits to having a mobile version of your neighborhood electronics store.

# Lists

## Creating and managing your list

### How do I create a shareable custom list?

You can create lists using items you’ve saved while shopping BestBuy.com. To create a custom list, you need to sign in to your My Best Buy® account. If you don't have one, you can create an account for free, which also gives you access to My Best Buy member benefits. Learn more about My Best BuyOnce you've signed in or created your account, there are a few ways to create your list. From BestBuy.com:Save items while shopping by clicking the Save for Later button on the item’s product detail page. The products you save will appear on the Saved Items page, which you can access from the navigation bar at the top of BestBuy.com. From the Saved Items page, click Add to List below any product you want to be a part of your new list. When prompted, choose to Create a New List, then title and save your list. From Best Buy mobile app:Open your Best Buy mobile app. If you do not have the app, text GETAPP to 332211* to download the Best Buy mobile app, or download it from your app store. Select your account name from the bottom navigation bar. Select Saved Items & Lists, then See All Lists from the upper right corner. Choose to Create a List, then title and save your new list. *Message and data rates may apply. For full terms and conditions, visit BestBuy.com/mobilefaqs. For info, text HELP to 332211. 

### How do I add an item to my custom lists?

Sign in to your account. On the Saved Items page, click the Add to List button underneath the saved item you want to add to your custom list. From Best Buy mobile app:Sign in to your account. Browse for items you want to add. Select the Add to Wish List button on an item's product detail page and then choose the list to which you would like to add the item, or select Create a New List. From Best Buy stores:Open your Best Buy mobile app. If you do not have the app, text GETAPP to 332211* to download the Best Buy mobile app, or download it from your app store. Scan the QR code on the price tag or bar code on the item's packaging.

## Frequently Asked Questions

App exclusive offers available for a limited time only or until they’re sold out. No rainchecks.

How can I download the Best Buy app to get access to Best Buy Drops®?

To download the app, visit our Best Buy app page on BestBuy.com for access to the App Store or Google Play. You can also text “App” to code 332211 to get a link to the download. (Message and data rates may apply. Terms and Privacy Policy apply.)

What kind of products can you find on Drops?

There are 2 types of products that we focus on for drops:

  1. Products with limited releases.
  2. Products with serious savings.

Either way, we will have limited inventory of these products due to their uniqueness or their great savings.

How long are Drops available?

They are available for a limited time or until sold out.

How often are Drops available?

Drops frequency varies. Check the Drops section on the Best Buy app often for new drops.

Is there a way to learn that a Drop is occurring soon?

Yes. Go to the Drops section on the Best Buy app. Once there, browse the Upcoming Drops section and click on the “Notify me for drop” on any product you are interested in. About 30 minutes before the drop, you will receive a push notification from the app letting you know that the drop will start soon. Remember to review your app notification settings to ensure you’re receiving the notification.

Can I find these Drops at my local Best Buy store?

Drops are only available for purchase within the Best Buy app and are unavailable in store or on a browser. Store Pickup is available for many Drops purchases.

Agent Tools is designed to make your work easier and to get your listings in front of even more potential renters and buyers. Key new features include:

  * Seamless listing entry: The intuitive design helps you post listings faster and more accurately.
  * More detailed amenity options: Ne w amenity options include wheelchair accessibility, type of outdoor space and type of view among others.

# Best Buy Introduces Best Buy Drops™

By Best Buy September 26, 2023

Image: Image showing mobile screens for Best Buy Drops.

Drop what you’re doing and download the Best Buy App. Best Buy is unveiling a new experience today that gives shoppers a chance to access some of the biggest deals and coolest products of the holiday season — and it’s coming right to your mobile device. It’s called Best Buy Drops™.

This holiday season, Best Buy Drops is giving customers the opportunity to get their hands on exciting product releases, limited runs, launches and serious savings — all in real time. But you’ll need to act fast because each Drop is only available in limited quantities and exclusively through the Best Buy App.

Drops will include special products and deals from a variety of categories, including gaming consoles and accessories, wearable devices, e-transportation products, small appliances, smart home, toys, and much more. The first Drop goes live on Sept. 27, with multiple drops coming nearly every week.

# Best Buy launches new way to shop its app through Google Play’s Collections

By Best Buy July 24, 2024

Image: An illustration showing the Google Play's Collections screen featuring Best Buy.

In the coming weeks, Android users will have an exciting new way to shop the Best Buy® app with the rollout of Google Play’s Collections. We’re one of the first retailers to partner with Google on this new experience, which spotlights the most relevant content from your Android apps and brings it all into one easy-to-navigate feed.

When exploring Collections, you’ll have access to Best Buy’s latest deals, upcoming shopping events, reminders about hot products on Best Buy Drops™ and more, personalized entirely to you. Scrolling through your Collections feed and see something that sparks your interest? Tap into the tile and you’ll seamlessly be brought directly into the Best Buy app where you can find more details and unlock a whole new world of discovery with some awesome new features we’ve recently launched.

“This new way to engage with the Best Buy app through Collections perfectly demonstrates how we’re continuing to create personalized experiences for our customers,” said Brian Tilzer, chief data, analytics and technology officer at Best Buy. “We’re thrilled to be partnering with Google Play on the launch of Collections because it aligns with our goal to inspire our customers and help them discover how tech can bring what they love to the next level.”

## Best Buy features in Google Play’s Collections

Here’s some of what Android users can expect to see from the Best Buy app within Collections:  

  * Product and deal recommendations
  * Upcoming shopping events
  * Details on the next Best Buy Drops™
  * Our “Deal of the Day”
  * Recently viewed products
  * Items still left in your shopping cart

# ‘BlueAssist’ Puts Best Buy’s Expert Service in the Palm of Your Hand

By Best Buy December 2, 2015

Image: blue_assist_blog_pic_v01

Need help choosing between two TVs? Wondering whether the latest smartwatch is compatible with your smartphone? Want to check the status of a recent order?

Now you can get help on all of that and more with BlueAssist, a new live-chat feature within the Best Buy mobile app. With the simple touch of a button or shake of the phone (while the app is running), you can get expert service right in the palm of your hand.

“Previously, if you had a question or needed advice while browsing our mobile app, you were left with two options: call or email.  That’s too much effort for our customers and not always convenient,” said Pedram Afshar, vice president of customer experience for Best Buy. “The whole idea behind BlueAssist is to be their helping hand, digitally, without ever having to switch channels.”

All BlueAssist chats are prioritized to receive a response within seconds. You can also choose to call Best Buy, request a call back or send an email.

You can access BlueAssist at any point while shopping in the app, whether you’re on the home page, reviewing your cart or checking out. Plus, you can use it whether you’re in a Best Buy store, at home or on the go.

“BlueAssist is the first of many features we will bring to life to connect digital and physical experiences to create a truly seamless experience for our customers,” said Bala Subramanian, senior vice president and chief technology officer for Best Buy.

The enhanced Best Buy app also makes it easier than ever to research and purchase Holiday gifts from a mobile device.

Download the mobile app on the Best Buy website, by texting APP to 332211 or searching “Best Buy” in the Apple App Store or Google Play.
